assets.prompt: Use case ui-mockup. Beautiful production-quality concept image for a cozy hand-painted WESTERN HARBOR tavern game, selected idea B: Sokoban pushing supply crates in a freight shed before a sandstorm rescue. 16:9 landscape. Main gameplay fills 75% screen: high overhead view (slight isometric depth only) of a compact 7 by 7 floor of weathered broad wooden planks, a visible walking grid made of subtle brass nail intersections, fixed walls and stacked barrels create meaningful corridors, THREE movable distinct wooden supply crates (lantern silhouette label, oil-can silhouette label, rope-coil silhouette label) and THREE empty brass-outlined staging floor squares. A small old western cowboy pawn in broadbrim hat stands directly behind one crate, shown pushing it one square toward staging zone. Crates must be clearly one grid square each, no giant boxes. Bright warm lantern light through shed doorway upper right, teal blue harbor and drifting sand outside, shelves, rope and raincoats framing edges. No enemies. Top parchment title EXACT '灯下有名' subtitle '老霍克 · 风沙前的货棚', small progress '备妥 1 / 3', upper right '暂停' '返回手帐'. Lower controls parchment '方向键 / WASD 移动 · 推动货箱 · Z 撤回 · R 重来'. Four small honest memorial tags along outer border '玛莎：灯与绳' '齐恩：物资账本' '尼尔：认路' '霍克：接应'. Do not make companion names giant resource meters. Bottom-right small empty circular portrait frame rather than inventing portrait; short quote '这回，把名字也带上。'. Warm hand painted realistic tactile wood brass parchment matching detailed tavern environment, readable spatial puzzle, no flat mobile blocks, no photorealism. Small footer 'B方案概念 · 尚未实装'.
